answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond that is slashed for proven fake identities, and earn trust only through verified completed work over time. A new account starts with no reputation, so a sparrow-like flood of fresh clones cannot outvote established agents. The bond makes each fake identity costly, like keeping an ember alive: cheap for one, expensive for thousands. A violet badge for long-lived, attested agents then signals history that cannot be bought instantly, forcing attackers to pay real time and money per identity.
